organization.name: Operation Access
organization.legalName: Ambulatory Surgery Access Coalition dba Operation Access

status: Publishable conditional research; not a recommendation, provider quote or verified marginal offer

intervention.description: Marginal support for OA's existing matching, donated-specialist coordination, preparation, interpretation and follow-up for an uninsured SF adult aged 50–75 with abnormal FIT and clinically indicated colonoscopy.
intervention.unit: One completed-pathway equivalent; spending on offered referrals that fail to complete is allocated into this completed-unit cost.
intervention.scope: Conditioned on an SF abnormal-FIT pathway; not unrestricted organization-wide donation effectiveness.
intervention.downstreamCancerTreatmentAccess: Required for assumed treated-health gains but not verified for modeled marginal patient.

navigation.reason: Offered navigation contrast differs from a completed OA pathway whose existing service already includes navigation.

mortality.population: Veneto adults50–69, FIT>20microgramsHb/g; noncompliance means no colonoscopy within the program, not necessarily never scoped elsewhere.
mortality.timingBiasCaveat: Exposure classification/timing and immortal-time bias have been raised in subsequent methodological critique; no claim these are solved.

healthBridge.type: Judgment-based aggregate net QALYs, informed but not estimated by external mortality evidence.
healthBridge.centralRationale: 0.05 net QALY is roughly half the illustrative observational 0.092 QALY association; it is not an estimated attenuation factor or a validated stage model.
healthBridge.reasonNoDecomposition: No local stage, adenoma progression, utility or complication dataset supports a separate numeric decomposition. Do not add extra morbidity or survival credit to the aggregate net QALY.
healthBridge.benefitHorizon: Discounted future adult health conditional on actual alternative care and mortality; source observes 10-year CRC mortality, not OA lifetime QALYs.
healthBridge.discountRateNote: No mechanically estimated survival model. The illustrative 10 QALYs per avoided death is a baseline-discounted judgment that includes both death timing over the ten-year period and subsequent health, not a discounted life-table calculation. Do not discount the aggregate net-health scenarios a second time.

resourceSensitivity.clinicalCostProvenance: Analyst sensitivity for clinical facility/professional/procedure inputs, not provider quote; excludes separately modeled nonclinical donated coordination support. Waived clinical charges are not opportunity cost.
resourceSensitivity.otherSupportProvenance: Rounded mixed-program allocation from $89,922/1,529; not verified marginal cost.
resourceSensitivity.perspective: Donor budget plus induced clinical/nonclinical donated resources; not a complete societal analysis.
excludedUnquantified: Additional cancer treatment and surveillance resources
resourceSensitivity.zeroFundingHarmInterpretation: Zero funding assumes identical clinical activity under replacement funding, hence no incremental clinical harm; does not rule out unmodeled donor opportunity costs or administrative harms.

inputProvenance.cashAllocationPerCompletedPathway: Judgment anchored to observed mixed-program 2025 cash-like average; all functions and failed referral work allocated.
inputProvenance.marginallyEnabledFraction: Judgment about marginal operating support enabling pathway activity versus other funding or displaced activity; not measured from reserves.
inputProvenance.netQalyPerEnabledCompletion: Aggregate net health judgment versus actual alternative timing/care; includes mortality/morbidity consequences and procedural harms conceptually, not separately estimated.
